data.narrative:
Shield AI, a Series G defense & security company, commands a current post-money valuation of $12.7B after raising $1.5B+. The valuation assessment draws from a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms in the defense & security sector, including Anduril Industries ($61.0B, Series H), Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), Flock Safety ($7.5B, Series G), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D).

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-progression analysis, anchoring to the $5.6B last post-money valuation and applying a standard 1.25x Series G step-up multiplier, implies $7.0B. Peer-median methodology across the 9 same-sector, similar-valuation-tier comparables yields $7.5B, with the peer set ranging from $3.0B to $61.0B floor and ceiling. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage and technology focus within defense infrastructure.

These methods triangulate to a median fair value of $7.2B (range: $6.0B–$8.6B), substantially below Shield AI's stated $12.7B valuation. The variance suggests either: (i) post-money uplift from recent capital deployment or strategy not captured in backward-looking peer data, (ii) valuation asymmetry within the defense tech sector reflecting investor concentration, or (iii) base case incorporating revenue visibility or profitability trajectory not present in earlier-stage comparables. Key uncertainty centers on whether Shield AI's technology differentiation commands a sustained premium relative to the peer median.
